data.name: Eupheemia
data.gender_notes: Eupheemia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word eu, meaning 'good, well,' and pheme, meaning 'voice, reputation.' In ancient Greece, this name was given to those born during times of peace and prosperity. In Christianity, it is associated with the joy and happiness found in a close relationship with God. The name Eupheemia carries the meaning “Joyful in God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eupheemia usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful in god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with joy and divine grace.
data.etymology: Eupheemia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful in God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eupheemia total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
